title: Epidemic Spread Simulation
description: Simulate the spread of a virus in a population of 1000 people to understand transmission dynamics.

interactions.name: infection_transmission
interactions.description: Transmission of the virus from an infected person to a susceptible person upon interaction.

metrics.name: number_of_infected
metrics.description: Tracks the number of currently infected people over time.

metrics.name: number_of_recovered
metrics.description: Tracks the number of people who have recovered from the infection over time.

metrics.name: number_of_susceptible
metrics.description: Tracks the number of people who are still susceptible to infection over time.

validation_criteria.name: basic_reproduction_number
validation_criteria.description: Evaluate if the average number of secondary infections produced by one infected individual is realistic.

validation_criteria.name: peak_infection_time
validation_criteria.description: Check if the time to reach peak infection aligns with theoretical expectations.
